scripts.build:site: npm run build --workspace=@arcadebench/partition && npm run build --workspace=@arcadebench/maltline && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.check:wrangler: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run && node scripts/audit-worker-bundle.mjs && npm run test:worker-bundle
scripts.security:prepush: npm run security:secrets && npm run security:privacy && npm run security:history
scripts.preview:site: npm run build:site && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs wrangler deploy --keep-vars
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/prepare-production-migrations.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply arcadebench-platform --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/prepare-production-migrations.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply arcadebench-platform --remote
